title: Prove the nested public, installed and web cascade
text: The source tree now uses recursive nav.yaml, meaningful nested homes, immediate-child summaries and generated breadcrumbs. The navigation contract defines CommonMark heading links and retires old public URLs without redirects. Source navigation is observed, not verified-live. Exact candidate installed/public bytes, the real Platform consumer build, coupled release pin, released attribution and authorized private receiving/rollback evidence remain pending; source structure alone closes none of those proof requirements.
owner: Yoke candidate verification and Platform consumer delivery
